0.comment: Dainsleif: Vedrfolnir and the palace raid
0.content: Vedrfolnir, "The Visionary," is Dainsleif's elder brother and Khaenri'ah's court prophet. He spoke an unwelcome prophecy at court, and King Irmin (the Vinster King) had him blinded and thrown into the dungeon. Dainsleif called this not the conduct of a wise ruler, gathered his allies and stormed the palace by night. The rescue succeeded, but every one of the allies took a share of the Abyssal power, Vedrfolnir among them. In Dainsleif's words, even the person he came to rescue abandoned him.

1.content: The Five Sinners were Vedrfolnir ("The Visionary"), Hroptatyr ("The Wise"), Rhinedottir ("Gold"), Surtalogi ("The Foul") and Rerir ("Rächer of Solnari"). Dainsleif says they were the best of their peers and that, together with him, they should have prevented the disaster. Instead each divided a power that could destroy the world, and when the Cataclysm came none of them defended Khaenri'ah. He says he will never forgive them.

2.content: After the Cataclysm Ronova cursed pure-blooded Khaenri'ahns with immortality. Dainsleif says the curse denies death but not erosion: body and soul wear away until almost nothing remains, which is why hilichurls wear masks and seek dark corners to rest. He has lived through the curse fully conscious for five hundred years.

3.content: Dainsleif and the Traveler's sibling travelled together after the Cataclysm in a painful search for their fates, but did not reach the journey's end together. Dainsleif knows places' stories because the sibling wanted to hear them. The sibling later led the Abyss Order, and the Traveler first learned of the connection when the sibling appeared in Mondstadt and called Dainsleif an enemy.

4.content: Haden was Dainsleif's instructor in Black Serpent Bladework at the Knight Academy and later an Iniquitous Baptist of the Abyss Order. Dainsleif disowns him, saying he stifled younger knights, and that Surtalogi was punished for honouring the spirit of knighthood. At Ochkanatlan Dainsleif killed him a hundred times as punishment for joining the Order, and a hundred more after Haden admitted he had lied about the homeland already being revived.

5.comment: Dainsleif: Halfdan and the Black Serpent Knights
5.content: Halfdan was a young elite of the Royal Guard whom Dainsleif ordered, on the day of disaster, to tell all Black Serpent Knights to protect the people of Khaenri'ah at all costs. Five hundred years later in the Chasm, Halfdan was a cursed knight who had kept his awareness and was guarding dying hilichurls. Dainsleif recognised him and tried to spare him.

6.comment: Dainsleif: Rerir and the Wild Hunt
6.content: Rerir was a Khaenri'ahn intelligence agent who reported to the Vinster King, and an acquaintance and friend of Dainsleif who had no grand ambitions. In Nod-Krai Dainsleif asked Nefer to investigate why Rerir became a Sinner, joined the alliance against the Wild Hunt, and tried to understand the man he knew.

7.comment: Dainsleif: Eftirvit, the Tsaritsa and Snezhnaya
7.content: Dainsleif calls Pierro "Eftirvit," his Khaenri'ah name, and dislikes his Fatui title. Asked if they are close, he says they were merely acquaintances who crossed paths a few times at the royal court. He came to Snezhnaya because Pierro contacted him about Ronova and Rhinedottir's visit, though he found the Fatui officers hunting for him so relentless that he half thought they meant to arrest him. He agreed to set aside his own agenda and focus entirely on Ronova.

8.comment: Dainsleif: Ronova battle in Rankova Zorya
8.content: He met the Traveler and Paimon at Rankova Zorya's train station, then Mitya and Vodyanitsa. Ronova arrived and killed everyone in the area; when the Traveler returned from the afterlife, Dainsleif was still in the fight. He restrained her leg, attacked with the Traveler, protected Pierro from her barrage, and shielded him from the dust of Pierro's final blow.

9.comment: Dainsleif: Commission terms and the Abyss hunt
9.content: When he first met the Traveler in Mondstadt's Angel's Share he asked 500 Mora in advance and three answered questions, about who was key to Mondstadt's crisis, who would defend Liyue now, and whether Vision-holders or others matter more to the gods. He only takes commissions related to the Abyss Order and tracks Abyss Heralds by Abyss Mage sigils, Ruin Guard footprints and the scent of the Abyss.

10.content: Skirk's voice-over says she hoped Dainsleif would tell her about her master but that the moment he recognised her bladework he became agitated and demanded to know Surtalogi's whereabouts. She wants to avoid him in future. Dainsleif studied with Surtalogi at the Knight Academy; in Ochkanatlan he recalled that Surtalogi was prosecuted and lost limbs for following the spirit of knighthood.

11.comment: Dainsleif: Kaeya and the Alberich name
11.content: In Port Ormos he told Kaeya the Alberich clan descends from the Abyss Order's founder Chlothar, saying he hoped it would change nothing if Kaeya had let go of his past. Kaeya recognised him as a pure-blooded Khaenri'ahn. Dainsleif says he does not know Kaeya well and will not jump to conclusions.

12.comment: Dainsleif: Capitano and the Natlan Abyss campaign
12.content: Capitano, wearing a mask in Natlan, said he knew only Dainsleif's name in Khaenri'ah and last saw him travelling with the Prince or Princess. He judged that Dainsleif carries pain and hatred far beyond his own. In Natlan (5.7) Dainsleif joined the Traveler and Iansan in fighting the Abyss Order's large-scale attack, saying he intended to make the Order's sacrifice greater and more painful than expected.
